about: GitHub's official server that lets AI assistants read and change repositories, issues and pull requests.

prs.title: Reading files over 1 MB works again
prs.broken: Since one release, asking for any file of 1 MB or more failed with an error. GitHub sends big files without their content, and the tool did not expect that reply.
prs.changed: I made it treat that reply as a big file and hand back a link to it, as it did before.
prs.matters: AI assistants can work with large files in a repository again instead of hitting an error.
